title: Fan Lao's End and the Life Devouring Pill
summary: Fan Lao leads the Black Alliance against Xiao Li's nameless organization and storms its fortress in the Black-Corner Region. As Fan Lao is about to make Xiao Li a Blood Slave, Xiao Yan arrives, and Xiao Li learns his brother is alive. Medusa turns up too, refuses Fan Lao's offer to team up and tells Xiao Yan his life is hers before she leaves. Zi Yan and Lin Yan take on two of Fan Lao's men while Xiao Yan burns Fan Lao to death with his Heavenly Flame, then breaks the rest of the attackers and sends word that he will soon come for Han Feng. Afterwards Xiao Li admits he took a Life Devouring Pill, which raised him from Da Dou Shi to Dou Wang but leaves him only three years to live. Xiao Yan takes its sealed prescription, promises an antidote within a year, and asks his brother to recover at the Jia Nan Academy.
